architecture_selection_reasoning: Selected Modular Monolith to satisfy move latency NFR-001 and game consistency for ST-001 and ST-002.

domain_glossary.definition: Unique identifier for an active multiplayer or AI chess match.
Standard UCI string notation denoting origin and destination board coordinates.

business_invariants.statement: Every chess game session must have a non-empty game_id and positive turn quantity.

criteria.gherkin: Given a valid game_id and positive quantity When the game endpoint is called Then the game session is persisted with status PROCESSED
Given a zero or negative quantity When the game endpoint is called Then a 422 DomainError is raised
Given an active game_id and legal move When the move endpoint is called Then the engine updates board state with status PROCESSED

nfrs.statement: P95 move evaluation latency must be under 50ms

components.name: chess-game-service
responsibilities: Manage chess match sessions, timer state, and player turns
components.architectural_reasoning: Coordinates multiplayer chess matches and turns satisfying NFR-001.

components.name: chess-engine-service
responsibilities: Validate legal piece moves, detect check and checkmate, and update board state
components.architectural_reasoning: Executes deterministic chess board rules and state transitions.

adrs.title: Hexagonal Chess Engine Monolith
adrs.decision: Enforce domain <- api boundary with separate engine and game services.
